title: AI Campus Assistant
tagline: Intelligent multi-agent chatbot for university courses, exams, fees, and academic circulars.
problem: University students struggle to navigate fragmented campus portals, outdated PDF circulars, and delayed administrative responses regarding exam timetables, fee dues, course syllabi, and hostel services.
solution: A centralized, conversational AI campus portal integrating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) over official college circulars, document question answering, fee reminders, and role-based student query ticketing.
targetUsers: Undergraduate/Postgraduate Students, Faculty, Academic Advisors, and Administrative Staff.

basic: Conversational Chat Interface with chat history
Categorized FAQ System with fast keyword search
advanced: RAG over College Handbooks & Circulars (PDF parsing & vector search)
Personalized Academic Reminders (Internal exams, fee deadlines, hall tickets)
Context-Aware Document Answering with source citations
future: Campus navigation with interactive 3D floor maps

frontend.name: React + Tailwind CSS
frontend.rationale: Enables a responsive, accessible mobile-friendly dashboard with rapid UI prototyping.

backend.name: FastAPI (Python)
backend.rationale: Asynchronous high-performance Python framework with native async support for AI/LLM streaming.

database.name: PostgreSQL + pgvector / ChromaDB
database.rationale: Relational integrity for user data and fast vector similarity search for campus circular RAG.

ai.name: Google Gemini API / LangChain / HuggingFace Embeddings
ai.rationale: High context window for long academic PDF circulars and cost-effective embeddings.

deployment.name: Docker + Render / Vercel
deployment.rationale: Free tier friendly, zero-downtime deployments with containerized reproducibility.

tasks.task: Survey 30+ students on campus portal friction points
Collect official college circulars, rulebooks, and course syllabi
Draft System Requirements Specification (SRS)
Design Wireframes in Figma for Student & Admin views
Build responsive Chat Interface with message bubbles
Create Student Dashboard and Notice Explorer
Set up PostgreSQL database schema and migrations
Implement JWT student authentication & authorization
Develop CRUD APIs for notices, user profiles, and chat logs
Implement PDF text extraction and semantic chunking
Generate vector embeddings and store in vector database
Build prompt engineering pipeline with ground truth citation
Integrate Google Gemini API with fallback handling
Perform RAG retrieval accuracy and hallucination checks
Conduct unit testing on authentication & API endpoints
User acceptance testing with 10 peer students
Deploy backend to Render and frontend to Vercel
Prepare final academic project report & slide deck
Record working demo video and prepare viva presentation

improvements.suggestion: Add automated email notifications to faculty mentors when students report recurring grievances.
Implement Redis caching for top 50 common campus questions to achieve sub-50ms response times.
Enforce strict student email domain validation (@college.edu) and sanitize PDF uploads against malware.
Incorporate a dark mode switch and quick-reply chips for trending topics like 'Exam Schedule' and 'Library Timings'.
Implement multi-turn conversation memory with hybrid search (BM25 keyword + dense vector embeddings) for higher precision.
Migrate to asynchronous Celery worker queues for batch PDF processing during semester circular release spikes.

title: MediScan: Clinical Report & Symptom AI
tagline: Explainable medical diagnostic assistant simplifying lab reports and triage recommendations.
problem: Patients often struggle to understand complex clinical laboratory blood tests and pathology reports, leading to anxiety or missed critical markers before consulting a doctor.
solution: An OCR-enabled diagnostic portal that extracts blood test markers, flags abnormal ranges in layman terms, provides preliminary triage assessments, and produces printable doctor summary briefs.
targetUsers: Patients, caregivers, telemedicine triage staff, and general health clinic visitors.

advanced: Multimodal Medical LLM reasoning for differential explanations
Interactive Biomarker Trend Charts across historical visits
Emergency Red-Flag detector with immediate caution alerts
future: Wearable device telemetry sync (Apple Health / Google Fit)

frontend.name: Next.js / React + Chart.js
frontend.rationale: High performance server-rendered dashboards with interactive visual health trend charts.

backend.name: Python FastAPI + Celery
backend.rationale: Robust async processing for heavy image preprocessing and OCR extraction pipelines.

database.name: PostgreSQL with encrypted JSONB fields
database.rationale: Flexible semi-structured lab test parameters with strict relational patient mapping.

ai.name: Gemini 1.5 Flash Vision / PyTesseract / HuggingFace BioGPT
ai.rationale: Native multimodal comprehension of scanned lab sheets and specialized medical terminology.

deployment.name: AWS EC2 / GCP Cloud Run with S3 for encrypted storage
deployment.rationale: Compliant bucket storage with pre-signed URLs for sensitive diagnostic reports.

tasks.task: Study standard CBC, Lipid, and Metabolic blood panel formats
Define disclaimer and ethical boundaries for AI diagnostic support
Implement image deskewing and adaptive thresholding pipeline
Extract tabular parameters using Vision API
Build biomarker reference database (normal ranges by age/gender)
Prompt pipeline for simplified layman explanation synthesis
Build trend charts for cholesterol, glucose, and hemoglobin
Generate 1-click printable Doctor PDF Brief
Test against 50 anonymized public lab report samples
Implement mandatory clinical disclaimers and safety alerts
Deploy cloud infrastructure with HTTPS & encrypted uploads
Compile final project documentation & research paper draft

improvements.suggestion: Add drug-drug interaction checker when patients input active medication lists.
Implement WebP image compression in frontend before uploading large scanned documents.
Strip all EXIF metadata and PII from uploaded images before processing.
Provide confidence scores for every extracted biomarker to prevent OCR misreads.
Integrate HL7 / FHIR data standards for interoperability with hospital Electronic Health Records (EHR).

title: AgroSense: IoT & Vision Crop Health Predictor
tagline: Precision agriculture system predicting plant diseases and recommending optimal irrigation.
problem: Smallholder farmers suffer severe crop losses due to undetected early-stage fungal/bacterial leaf infections and inefficient flood irrigation leading to water wastage.
solution: An integrated IoT micro-station that monitors soil moisture, temperature, and humidity, paired with a mobile-friendly vision classifier identifying 38 leaf diseases with organic treatment plans.
targetUsers: Farmers, agricultural extension workers, greenhouse operators, and agritech researchers.

basic: ESP32 / Arduino sensor data telemetry (Soil moisture, DHT11)
Leaf photo upload for disease screening
advanced: Computer vision leaf disease diagnosis (CNN / MobileNetV3)
Automated solenoid valve trigger based on soil moisture threshold
Organic and chemical treatment dosage calculator
SMS alert notification for urgent frost or disease risks
future: Localized mandi price forecasting using time-series ML
Solar-powered offline edge AI device (Raspberry Pi / Jetson Nano)

frontend.name: PWA (Progressive Web App) with Vite + Tailwind
frontend.rationale: Enables offline capability and home-screen installation on low-end Android smartphones.

backend.name: Node.js / Express or Python Flask with MQTT Broker
backend.rationale: Lightweight MQTT protocol handling for low-bandwidth IoT sensor telemetry.

database.name: InfluxDB / TimescaleDB (Time series) + SQLite
database.rationale: Optimized for continuous sensor readings and environmental metrics over months.

ai.name: TensorFlow Lite / MobileNetV3 (PlantVillage dataset)
ai.rationale: Ultra-lightweight deep learning model capable of fast inference on low-latency connections.

deployment.name: HiveMQ Cloud (MQTT) + Railway / Render
deployment.rationale: Reliable IoT broker with zero maintenance overhead for student budgets.

tasks.task: Procure ESP32, capacitive soil sensor, and DHT22
Assemble breadboard prototype and test sensor readings
Program ESP32 WiFi & MQTT publish routines
Set up cloud MQTT broker and persistent time-series logging
Curate PlantVillage dataset (Tomato, Potato, Corn)
Fine-tune MobileNetV3 with data augmentation
Export model to TFLite for fast server inference
Build mobile-first leaf camera capture interface
Implement offline caching for treatment guidelines
Test sensor durability in real soil conditions
Validate disease accuracy on 30 freshly plucked leaves
Package hardware prototype inside weather-resistant 3D printed enclosure
Submit final documentation and demonstration video

Support LoRaWAN mesh networking for long-distance connectivity in remote farms without 4G.
